entities.summary: The Lalla ez-Zhar Mosque, or al-Zahr Mosque, is a mosque located in Fes el-Jdid in the historic old city of Fez, Morocco. It is also known by the name Jama’ el-Hajjar, probably in reference to its stone portal entrance. The mosque was founded or completed in 1357 CE by the Marinid sultan Abu Inan.
